A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a novel mAb, B1.4, reactive with a wide variety of malignant tumors, including invasive bladder cancer, but not with normal urinary epithel.
the antigen recognized with B1.4 is not a specific marker for human bladder cancer.
mAb B1,4 recognizes a tumor-associated antigen, and that this antigen is a potential target for immunotherapy of human bladder cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the antibody B1.4 is reactive with a high percentage of invasive bladder tumors, and that it can therefore be used to identify these tumors and distinguish them from non‐invasive tumors and normal urinary epithel.
